name: fara-pokemon-battle-assistant
description: Cloudflare Workers への公開用（wrangler のバージョン固定）。サイト本体は src/FaraPokemonBattleAssistant.Web

scripts.publish:web: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('publish', { recursive: true, force: true })" && dotnet publish src/FaraPokemonBattleAssistant.Web -c Release -o publish && node tools/build-entry-pages.mjs --env production
scripts.check: npm run publish:web && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env="" && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env develop
